compatibilityIssues: Migration from Web Forms to .NET 8 required
upgradeSteps: Refactor Web Forms to Razor Pages/MVC

issues.impact: Complete data access layer needs to be rewritten
issues.description: Application uses Entity Framework 6.2.0 which is not compatible with .NET 8. Must migrate to Entity Framework Core 8.0.0.
issues.recommendation: Replace EntityFramework 6.2.0 with Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 8.0.0 and related packages. Update all DbContext and entity configurations to EF Core syntax.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6.2.0 Not Compatible with .NET 8

issues.impact: All logging statements need to be updated
issues.description: Application uses log4net 2.0.10 which is legacy and not recommended for .NET 8 applications.
issues.recommendation: Replace log4net with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging or Serilog.AspNetCore 8.0.0. Update all ILog references to ILogger<T>.
issues.title: log4net Not Recommended for .NET 8

issues.impact: Core web functionality needs complete rewrite
issues.description: Application heavily uses System.Web which is not available in .NET 8. Found references in project file and code files.
issues.recommendation: Replace all System.Web usages with ASP.NET Core equivalents. Use IHttpContextAccessor instead of HttpContext.Current, IWebHostEnvironment instead of Server.MapPath.
issues.title: System.Web Dependencies Throughout Application

issues.codeSnippet: <%@ Page Title="Home Page" Language="C#" MasterPageFile="~/Site.Master" AutoEventWireup="true" CodeBehind="Default.aspx.cs" Inherits="eShopLegacyWebForms._Default" %>
issues.impact: Entire UI layer needs to be rewritten
issues.description: Found 7 .aspx pages using Web Forms server controls, page lifecycle, and code-behind pattern which are not supported in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Razor Pages or MVC Controllers. Replace server controls with HTML helpers or tag helpers. Implement pagination using modern patterns.
issues.title: ASP.NET Web Forms Pages Need Complete Rewrite

issues.impact: Layout and shared UI components need restructuring
issues.description: Application uses Site.Master and Site.Mobile.Master which are Web Forms concepts not available in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace master pages with layout pages (_Layout.cshtml) in ASP.NET Core. Move shared content and navigation to layout files.
issues.title: Master Pages Not Supported in .NET 8

issues.codeSnippet: protected void Page_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
issues.impact: Page initialization and event handling logic needs rewriting
issues.description: Code-behind files use Page_Load and other Web Forms lifecycle events which don't exist in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace Page_Load with appropriate Razor Pages OnGet/OnPost methods or MVC Controller actions. Restructure initialization logic.
issues.title: Page Lifecycle Events Not Available

issues.impact: All UI controls need to be replaced with modern equivalents
issues.description: Application uses ListView, HyperLink, ContentPlaceHolder and other Web Forms server controls that don't exist in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace server controls with HTML elements, Razor syntax, and modern UI frameworks. Use foreach loops instead of ListView, regular <a> tags instead of HyperLink.
issues.title: Web Forms Server Controls Not Supported

issues.impact: Configuration system needs complete overhaul
issues.description: Application configuration is in Web.config format which is not used in .NET 8 applications.
issues.recommendation: Migrate configuration to appsettings.json format. Move connection strings, app settings, and other configuration to JSON-based configuration system.
issues.title: Web.config Not Used in .NET 8

issues.impact: Dependency injection container configuration needs updating
issues.description: Application uses Autofac.Integration.Web which is specific to Web Forms and not compatible with .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace with built-in ASP.NET Core dependency injection or update to Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection for .NET 8 compatibility.
issues.title: Autofac Integration Needs Update

issues.codeSnippet: protected void Application_Start(object sender, EventArgs e)
issues.impact: Application lifecycle and initialization logic needs restructuring
issues.description: Application_Start, Session_Start, and other Global.asax events don't exist in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Move application startup logic to Program.cs. Replace session events with distributed cache or stateless design patterns.
issues.title: Global.asax Application Events Not Available

issues.impact: HTTP context access patterns need updating throughout application
issues.description: Code uses HttpContext.Current pattern which is not available in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace with IHttpContextAccessor injection pattern. Use HttpContext property instead of static Current property.
issues.title: HttpContext.Current Usage

issues.impact: Session management needs complete redesign
issues.description: Web Forms session state configuration in Web.config not applicable to .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Configure session state using ASP.NET Core session middleware or migrate to stateless architecture with distributed cache.
issues.title: Session State Configuration Incompatible

issues.impact: HTTP request pipeline processing needs redesign
issues.description: Application uses HTTP modules for Autofac and telemetry which need to be converted to middleware.
issues.recommendation: Replace HTTP modules with ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline. Implement container disposal and telemetry as middleware components.
issues.title: HTTP Modules Need Migration to Middleware

issues.impact: Static file bundling and optimization needs replacement
issues.description: ASP.NET Web Forms bundling and minification configuration not compatible with .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace with ASP.NET Core bundling solutions like WebOptimizer or Webpack. Update script and style bundling configuration.
issues.title: Web Optimization Bundle Configuration

issues.impact: URL routing system needs complete rewrite
issues.description: Web Forms routing using RouteTable.Routes not available in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to ASP.NET Core endpoint routing. Update route configuration to use MapRazorPages() or MapControllerRoute().
issues.title: Routing Configuration Incompatible

issues.impact: URL rewriting and friendly URLs need modern implementation
issues.description: Multiple Microsoft.AspNet.* packages are .NET Framework specific and not compatible with .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace with ASP.NET Core equivalents. Use routing constraints and route templates instead of FriendlyUrls.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet Packages Not Compatible

issues.impact: Telemetry and monitoring may need configuration updates
issues.description: Using older Application Insights packages that may need updating for .NET 8 compatibility.
issues.recommendation: Update to latest Application Insights packages compatible with .NET 8. Verify telemetry collection still works correctly.
issues.title: Application Insights Legacy Packages

issues.codeSnippet: Server controls with potential ViewState usage
issues.impact: State management between requests needs redesign
issues.description: Web Forms pages may rely on ViewState for maintaining control state across postbacks.
issues.recommendation: Identify ViewState usage and replace with stateless alternatives like hidden fields, TempData, or client-side state management.
issues.title: ViewState Dependencies

issues.impact: User interaction patterns need to be redesigned
issues.description: Application relies on Web Forms postback model for handling user interactions.
issues.recommendation: Replace postback model with HTTP GET/POST patterns using Razor Pages or MVC controllers. Use form submissions and AJAX for user interactions.
issues.title: Postback Event Model

issues.impact: All data binding expressions need syntax conversion
issues.description: Uses Web Forms data binding expressions (<%#:Item.Property%>) which are not available in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace with Razor syntax (@Model.Property) or HTML encoding functions in Razor Pages/MVC views.
issues.title: Data Binding Expressions

issues.impact: Reusable UI components need conversion to modern patterns
issues.description: ViewSwitcher.ascx user control needs to be converted to a different pattern in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Convert user controls to Partial Views or View Components in ASP.NET Core. Implement mobile detection using different approach.
issues.title: User Control (.ascx) Migration

issues.impact: Frontend libraries should be updated for security and features
issues.description: Using older versions of jQuery (3.5.0) and Bootstrap (4.3.1) which should be updated.
issues.recommendation: Update to latest stable versions of jQuery and Bootstrap for better security and features. Verify compatibility with new markup.
issues.title: Older jQuery and Bootstrap Versions

issues.impact: Project file structure needs modernization
issues.description: Project targets .NET Framework 4.7.2 which needs to be changed to net8.0.
issues.recommendation: Update project file to SDK-style format and change TargetFramework to net8.0. Remove .NET Framework specific references.
issues.title: Target Framework Version Update Required

recommendations: Migrate from Entity Framework 6 to Entity Framework Core 8. This is the most critical migration as it affects the entire data access layer. Update DbContext, entity configurations, and LINQ queries.
Convert Web Forms pages to Razor Pages. This involves rewriting .aspx pages, converting server controls to HTML/Razor syntax, and implementing new navigation patterns.
Migrate Web.config to appsettings.json and configure services in Program.cs. Update dependency injection, logging, and other configuration.
Replace log4net with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging or Serilog. Update all logging statements and configuration.
Update Autofac integration or migrate to built-in ASP.NET Core DI container. Update service registrations and injection patterns.
